column1: # Aeterna Noctis (Switch, update 3.2.000 = v458752). Provisional: from the survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py), memory keys as SPY×ANYA's Android profile.
# Unity 2022.2.5f1 IL2CPP, FMOD, SDK 15.3.2, NVN. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (the sdk and subsdk0 builds of Blasphemous 2).
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap. The heap check did not run (no Mac host: the Android path only).
# alias region 16 GB (SPY×ANYA's and Splatoon Raiders' size; address space only on Android) beside the Switch's 3285 MB pool: a smaller pool can refuse the
# game's maps on Android, and a 4.375 GB alias region can fill with StandardAllocator's region and Unity's own (docs/reference/memory.md)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# PEANUTS: the game presents at interval 1 with no engine limit the host writes. Display-paced caps from 20 to 120 are offered as experimental; the app starts it at
# 60 (the default since Peanuts Native 0.1.8: DM_FPS_LIMIT=60, DM_PRESENT_INTERVAL=display), and Game owned is the game's own pacing at its own 60 fps
